'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Greetings. Here's the thing: you can see for yourself how far out in the wilderness I live. Things happen out here. Sometimes I find a good person clinging to life, and there's nothing I can do to help. I've had people breathe their last right in my arms. I want to put together a small medical kit, something with the essentials always close at hand. Will you help me?}}

==Objectives==
* Find 4 items from the Medkits category [[Found in raid|<font color="red">Found In Raid</font>]]
* Hand over the items
* Find 4 items from the Injury treatment category [[Found in raid|<font color="red">Found In Raid</font>]]
* Hand over the items
==Rewards==
* +3,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Jaeger]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.1'''</font>
* 80,000 Roubles
** 84,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 92,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|Got it? Great. Hopefully, I won't have to watch people die helplessly anymore.}}

==Guide==
===Medical Category===
For the Medical category you can hand over the following  [[Found in raid|<font color="red">Found In Raid Items</font>]]    [[Salewa]], [[Grizzly medical kit]], [[AFAK tactical individual first aid kit]], [[AI-2 medkit]], [[IFAK individual first aid kit]], [[Car first aid kit]].

===Injury treatment===
For the Injury category you can hand over the following  [[Found in raid|<font color="red">Found In Raid Items</font>]]   [[Esmarch tourniquet]], [[Immobilizing splint]], [[Surv12 field surgical kit]], [[CALOK-B hemostatic applicator]], [[CMS surgical kit]], [[Aseptic bandage]], [[Golden Star balm]], [[Vaseline balm]], [[Army bandage]], [[Tigzresq splint]].
